answer_1.quote: Text Simplification (TS) aims to make texts more accessible by rewriting them in simpler language... this paper focuses specifically on lexical simplification (LS), a subtask of TS that replaces complex words in a context sentence with simpler alternatives.
answer_1.outputs: Simpler alternatives to complex words in a context sentence

answer_2.quote: To automatically evaluate the performance of LS systems, we used Accuracy@1@top1 (ACC) and Potential@1 (POT)...

answer_4.quote: To gain a more nuanced understanding of LS quality and safety from a user perspective, we conducted a manual evaluation... taking into account the standard human evaluation criteria of fluency, adequacy, and simplicity in TS, we defined the following four harmful tags: Grammar Error, Change of Meaning, More Difficult, Gibberish.
answer_4.guideline: assigned harmfulness tags to the alternatives generated by each system, focusing on instances not covered by automatic metrics, using defined harmful tags: Grammar Error, Change of Meaning, More Difficult, Gibberish.
